# fmpplugin

NEC **PC-98** FMP driver music, including the **OPNA hardware-rhythm drums**.

Extensions: `.opi` `.ovi` `.ozi`

The YM2608 (OPNA) ADPCM rhythm ROM lives in `fmgen`; without it the rhythm
channel is silent. See also [s98plugin](../s98plugin/README.md), which shares the
same OPNA rhythm support.
